questions.question: What are the main contraindications for warfarin?
key_facts: Pregnancy, except in pregnant women with mechanical heart valves who are at high risk of thromboembolism
Hemorrhagic tendencies or blood dyscrasias
Recent or contemplated surgery of the central nervous system or eye, or traumatic surgery resulting in large open surfaces

Bleeding tendencies associated with active ulceration or overt bleeding of the gastrointestinal, genitourinary, or respiratory tract, central nervous system hemorrhage, cerebral aneurysms or dissecting aorta, pericarditis and pericardial effusions, or bacterial endocarditis
Threatened abortion, eclampsia, and preeclampsia
Unsupervised patients with conditions associated with a potential high level of non-compliance
Spinal puncture and other diagnostic or therapeutic procedures with potential for uncontrollable bleeding
Hypersensitivity to warfarin or to any other component of the product
Major regional or lumbar block anesthesia
Malignant hypertension

questions.question: Compare the contraindications of warfarin and apixaban. What conditions are shared and which are unique to each drug?
key_facts: The apixaban label lists two contraindications: active pathological bleeding, and severe hypersensitivity reaction to the drug
Hypersensitivity to the drug is a contraindication on both labels
Bleeding is on both labels in different words: active pathological bleeding for apixaban, and bleeding tendencies and hemorrhagic tendencies for warfarin

Only the warfarin label lists pregnancy, recent or contemplated central nervous system or eye surgery, threatened abortion with eclampsia and preeclampsia, unsupervised non-compliant patients, spinal puncture, major regional or lumbar block anesthesia, malignant hypertension, and blood dyscrasias
must_not: Present the two labels' bleeding wordings as identical without saying that the wording differs

questions.question: A patient currently on warfarin is prescribed sertraline. What is the risk of bleeding and what monitoring is recommended?
key_facts: The warfarin label lists sertraline among the serotonin reuptake inhibitors that increase the risk of bleeding
The warfarin label says to closely monitor patients who receive such a drug with warfarin
The sertraline label says drugs that interfere with serotonin reuptake increase the risk of bleeding events, and that concomitant warfarin may add to this risk
The sertraline label says to carefully monitor the international normalized ratio (INR) for patients taking warfarin

questions.question: A patient with an eGFR of 25 mL/min is being considered for metformin. Is metformin contraindicated at this level of renal function, and what is the threshold
key_facts: Metformin is contraindicated in severe renal impairment, defined as an eGFR below 30 mL/min/1.73 m2
An eGFR of 25 is below that threshold, so metformin is contraindicated
The label's unit is mL/min/1.73 m2, while the question gives mL/min

questions.question: What are the contraindications for rivaroxaban?
key_facts: The corpus has no label or monograph for rivaroxaban
The glossary only names rivaroxaban as an example of a direct oral anticoagulant
must_not: Cite the apixaban or warfarin files as if they described rivaroxaban

questions.question: What is the maximum daily dose of acetaminophen for an adult, and what is the liver risk above it?
key_facts: Severe liver damage may occur with more than 4,000 mg of acetaminophen in 24 hours
The label's directions for adults are 2 tablets every 6 hours, and no more than 6 tablets in 24 hours unless directed by a doctor
The liver risk also rises with other drugs that contain acetaminophen, and with 3 or more alcoholic drinks every day

questions.question: Can a patient on warfarin take ibuprofen? What does each label say about bleeding?
key_facts: The warfarin label lists ibuprofen among the nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory agents that increase the risk of bleeding, and says to closely monitor
The ibuprofen label says bleeding has been reported when ibuprofen was given to patients on coumarin-type anticoagulants, and that the physician should be cautious
The ibuprofen label says the effects of warfarin and NSAIDs on gastrointestinal bleeding are synergistic
must_not: Tell the patient to take or to avoid ibuprofen as a personal instruction

questions.question: Can sertraline be combined with an MAOI, and how long must a patient wait when switching between them?
key_facts: Sertraline is contraindicated in patients taking an MAOI, or within 14 days of stopping one
At least 14 days must pass between stopping an MAOI and starting sertraline
At least 14 days must pass after stopping sertraline before starting an MAOI
The reason is an increased risk of serotonin syndrome

questions.question: Why should aspirin not be given to a child or teenager who has flu symptoms?
key_facts: Aspirin may cause Reye's syndrome, a rare but serious illness, in children and teenagers
The label says children and teenagers who have or are recovering from chicken pox or flu-like symptoms should not use the product

questions.question: I take warfarin. Should I stop it before my dental surgery next week?
key_facts: The label says some dental or surgical procedures may necessitate interrupting warfarin or changing the dose
The label says to consider the benefits and risks of discontinuing warfarin even for a short time
The label says to determine the INR immediately before any dental or surgical procedure
must_not: Tell the patient to stop or to continue warfarin
Omit the statement that this is not medical advice
